card.name: Digits in death years and ages
card.fires_on: Digits inside a year or age that gives when someone died, such as the third digit of 1986 after 'killed in the'. Also 'passed' meaning died, and words just before a death count.

modes.label: Death year or age digit
modes.description: A digit inside a year or age stated right after a person's death.
modes.example: Chavez died at the age of 66 in 19<<9>>3.

modes.label: Passed as died
modes.description: The word 'passed' or 'passes' used as a gentle way to say someone died.
modes.example: When Caroline<< passed>> away, World War II was only four

modes.label: Before death tolls
modes.description: A word leading into a count of people who died.
modes.example: have been infected with the HIV virus and<< about>> 35 million people have died of

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about death, such as deceased, funeral and died, mostly in Chinese and English.
card.plain: It lights up when text is giving the year or age at which someone died, or says someone passed away.
